title: Vanta's site on the Services theme: wire the Services skin into the site renderer and build Vanta's four pages

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03 16:21Z: govanta.pro rendered a bare logo and a giant name; build it all out from the Vanta design system on the Services theme

detail: govanta.pro had no saved theme, pages, menu or footer (195 bytes of preferences), and the Services skin had never been mounted in components/sites/site-page.tsx and site-chrome.tsx (LIVE-2040 left it standalone), so even a Space set to services would have drawn unstyled. This wires the Services sheet, faces and accent into the stand-alone site render (same shape as New World, LIVE-2057), adds lib/sites/vanta-site.ts (Home, Services, About, Free quote from the Vanta handoff, Services blocks only), scripts/seed-vanta.mts (guarded, prints the one transaction) and a guard test (lib/theme/existing-sites-keep-their-theme.test.ts) so a default-theme change cannot restyle a site that saved a theme. Phone and email are the design's sample record until the owner replaces them. Probe: node scripts/probes/services-site-wired.mjs.
